changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersionConditionItem') BEGIN create table metrics.AssetVersionConditionItem ( Uid uniqueidentifier CONSTRAINT DF_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_Uid DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, AssetVersionConditionUid uniqueidentifier NOT NULL, ConditionType int NOT NULL, ConditionFieldTypeID int NULL, ConditionIntersectTypeID int NULL, [Operator] varchar(10) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_FieldType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_FieldType] FOREIGN KEY([ConditionFieldTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[FieldType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_FieldType] END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_IntersectType') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_IntersectType] FOREIGN KEY([ConditionIntersectTypeID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[IntersectType] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersionConditionItem_IntersectType] END
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAssetVersionConditionItem') begin create clustered index CIX_MetricsAssetVersionConditionItem on [metrics].[AssetVersionConditionItem] ( AssetVersionConditionUid ) end GO
